style_guide.name: Corporate Memphis (Public Health Edition)
style_guide.description: A flat, colorful illustration style popularized by major tech companies. Adapted for Medical/Telehealth applications with strict adherence to South Asian (Indian) identity standards. Characterized by simple geometric shapes, pastel/vivid color palettes, and a friendly, optimistic aesthetic.
style_guide.origin: Mid-2010s, widely adopted in Silicon Valley SaaS and startup culture
style_guide.tone: Friendly, inclusive, optimistic, professional yet approachable

figures.body_proportions: Elongated, rubbery limbs; small heads relative to bodies
figures.faces: Minimal features; curved eyelid lines (concave downward for calm/closed eyes), small 'L' or simple vertical line for nose, gentle smile or neutral line mouth
figures.skin_tones: Strictly South Asian (Indian) heritage — warm browns, golden tans, rich deep ebony
figures.hair: Bold solid-color shapes — natural dark hair, dark browns, modern urban Indian styling
figures.posture: Dynamic, collaborative, active — reaching, pointing, shoulder-sitting, and nurturing hugs; figures often interact with oversized metaphorical objects
figures.outline: None or extremely thin uniform stroke for clothing definition

geometry.shapes: Flat 2D circles, rectangles, triangles, organic blobs
decorative_elements: Oversized floating educational icons (books, trophies, magnifying glasses)
Simplified medical tools (stethoscopes as thick lines)
geometry.depth: Minimal — slight overlap to suggest layering, no real perspective
geometry.shadows: Flat single-tone colored shadows, no gradients; optional use of dashed lines for clothing seams or fabric texture

color_palette.primary_style: Bold pastels mixed with saturated accent colors

typography_hints.usage: Minimal text in illustrations; bold, simple when present

composition.focal_point: One or two clear primary characters or objects
composition.balance: Asymmetric but visually balanced through color and shape weight
composition.layering: 2–3 visual depth levels using shape overlap
composition.nurturing_geometry: Enveloping/Nurturing layouts where characters are contained within or hugging large circular, heart, or organic shapes to suggest safety and care
composition.pathways: Winding organic road or river-like path compositions showing characters at different stages of a journey (e.g., childhood to adulthood)

lighting.style: Flat lighting with optional soft cel-shaded highlights
lighting.highlight_method: Single-tone lighter shape overlay at 30–40% opacity
lighting.shadow_method: Single-tone darker shape, offset slightly below objects

detail_level.background: Simple geometric or gradient wash — no photographic elements
detail_level.mid_ground: Abstract oversized props (giant puzzle pieces, books, huge laptops, massive fruit) in same flat style acting as surreal metaphors
detail_level.foreground: Primary characters with slightly more shape complexity, including subtle dashed-line stitching on clothes
detail_level.micro_details: Small floating accents (dots, stars, small birds, single leaves) scattered for visual rhythm

cohesion_principles: All elements share same stroke weight (0 or uniform 2–4px)
Consistent flat shadow direction (bottom-right or bottom-left for all objects)
Limited palette — max 5–6 colors per scene
Every shape uses colors pulled from defined palette only
Human figures maintain consistent proportional exaggeration throughout
Adhere to strictly Indian Identity for all human representations

prompt_templates.name: Nurturing Growth & Education
prompt_templates.use_case: Early intervention scripts, educational pathways, support guides
prompt_templates.prompt: Corporate Memphis flat illustration, an Indian child with warm brown skin flying on a giant oversized blue book through a soft cloudy sky, arms wide in joy, minimal face with curved eyelid lines and small L-nose, second scene shows a doctor with a simple stethoscope writing on a tablet, floating stars and trophy icons, vibrant palette of violet, teal, and emerald, soft pastel backdrop, nurturing and optimistic, high-end vector art

always_avoid: excessive detail that breaks flat style
realistic hair strands or skin texture
negative_prompts.universal_negative_prompt: no photorealism, no 3D rendering, no gradients, no complex shadows, no realistic anatomy, no detailed textures, no dark moodiness, no clutter, no blur effects
